about.title: About me
about.bio: I'm an independent consultant specializing in TypeScript, React, and Node.js ecosystems. After over a decade of building production systems — from startups to enterprise — I now focus on helping teams navigate complex technical decisions. I bring deep expertise in frontend architecture, performance optimization, and modern JavaScript tooling. My approach is pragmatic: I help you choose the right tools, avoid over-engineering, and deliver value faster.

playground.title: Shape workshop
playground.intro: Recreate a generated silhouette from blue squares. Cut, rotate, and arrange them like a tangram, then check the similarity score.
playground.sourceHint: Take identical blocks whenever you need them. Every block can be cut more than once.
playground.nothingSelected: Select a block on the board
playground.keyboardHelp: Block: drag or use the arrow keys. Shift moves precisely, Q/E rotates, C opens the cutter, and Delete returns the block.
playground.cutDescription: Tap two large handles on the edge in sequence. The blue preview is kept; you can flip the kept side before confirming.
playground.nextCutPoint: You are now choosing point {point} of the cutting line.
playground.cutInvalid: This line does not remove a useful part of the block. Choose different handles or flip the side.

status.ready: A target has been generated. Take your first square and start building.
status.added: A new square appeared on the right side of the board.
status.selected: Block selected. Drag, rotate, or cut it.
status.cutApplied: Cut complete. You can cut the same block again.
status.cutInvalid: The cut did not change the block. Choose another line.
status.removed: The block has returned to the source.
status.limit: There are enough blocks on the board. Return one before taking another.
status.scored: The mage has judged your shape.
status.newRound: A new target is ready. Previously skipped shapes will not return in this pool.
status.poolRestarted: All 100 shapes have been used. A fresh pool has started without repeating the current shape.

results.excellent: You are really good with these blocks.
results.details: Next time, pay closer attention to the details.
results.effort: It looks like you did not put much effort into this one.
results.ignored: You simply could not be bothered.

resultMageAlt.excellent: The TypeScript mage looks on with pride, respect, and approval.
resultMageAlt.details: The TypeScript mage calmly accepts the expected result.
resultMageAlt.effort: The TypeScript mage crosses his arms and shows clear disappointment.
resultMageAlt.ignored: The TypeScript mage performs a deeply embarrassed facepalm.
resultMageAlt.hopeless: The TypeScript mage turns away and raises a hand to end the conversation.
